overview.overview:
New Mexico is projected to favor the Democratic nominee in 2028, with an expected margin of about 13 points and a plausible range from 4 to 22 points. The state backed the Democratic candidate by 10.8 points in 2020 and by 6.0 points in 2024, and it leans roughly seven points more Democratic than the nation as a whole.

No public polls or home-state candidates are recorded for the contest so far, so the outlook rests mainly on past results and the broader political environment. Statewide 2026 benchmarks show margins of 26.5 points in the Senate race and 14.7 points in the governor's race. With five electoral votes, New Mexico is unlikely to decide the Electoral College.
overview.watch: A sharp shift in the national environment or the emergence of a strong home-state candidate could move the expected margin here.
